LESSON: SINGING PERFORMANCE

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.4: Singing PERFORMANCE

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Singing PERFORMANCE. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform varied cultural singing games using props for enjoyment
2. express feelings through singing games for appreciation sing and dance cooperatively in pairs and small groups. Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. perform varied cultural singing games using props for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform varied cultural singing games using props for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. express feelings through singing games for appreciation sing and dance cooperatively in pairs and small groups. Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to express feelings through singing games for appreciation sing and dance cooperatively in pairs and small groups. Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Singing PERFORMANCE.
2. Explain Singing PERFORMANCE to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Singing PERFORMANCE.
4. Show that you can: perform varied cultural singing games using props for enjoyment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Singing PERFORMANCE. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Singing PERFORMANCE important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. perform varied cultural singing games using props for enjoyment
2. express feelings through singing games for appreciation sing and dance cooperatively in pairs and small groups. Core-Competence

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
